## Many new cells

The meristem at a root tip keeps adding new cells to the plant body. The root goes on growing longer for weeks, and its older parts get support and transport cells.

**Predict:** What happens to all these new cells?

options.text: All of them keep dividing for the whole life of the plant.
All of them stop dividing and become permanent cells.
Some stay meristematic and keep dividing, while others stop dividing and change.
